CMOS feedback shunt regulator
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 PWL(0 3.3 10u 3.3 10.02u 4.3 40u 4.3)
VR vref 0 1.2
VB vb 0 .9
IL out 0 PWL(0 .2m 20u .2m 20.02u .8m 30u .8m 30.02u .2m 40u .2m)
XDUT vdd 0 vref vb out fb astra_070_cmos_feedback_shunt_regulator
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec nominal range 2.3 2.5 unit=V
* @spec line range 2.3 2.5 unit=V
* @spec load range 2.3 2.5 unit=V
* @spec recovery range 2.3 2.5 unit=V
* @spec feedback range 1.15 1.25 unit=V
* @spec ripple range 0 0.1 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 5n 40u
meas tran nominal FIND v(out) AT=8u
meas tran line FIND v(out) AT=18u
meas tran load FIND v(out) AT=28u
meas tran recovery FIND v(out) AT=38u
meas tran feedback FIND v(fb) AT=28u
meas tran ripple PP v(out) FROM=35u TO=40u
write out.raw v(out) v(fb) v(vdd)
quit
.endc
.end
